caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate andiron composed mainly of brass or a similar golden metal, rendered in full color and placed in the foreground. The andiron features a tall, turned vertical post adorned with multiple horizontal ridges and a domed, layered top. This post is mounted on a scrolled base with three curled legs, each ending in a small ball foot. To the left, a smaller turned post is attached to the horizontal bar, which projects backward and is shaded in dark gray, indicating a metallic component likely meant to support logs. In the left background, there is a monochrome line drawing of the same andiron, including a front view, side view, and a labeled scale in inches. The word "INCHES" is written beneath the scale, and the artist’s name, "HANS KORSCH," appears in the lower right corner. The overall composition has a light beige background with a thin rectangular border.
title: Andiron (one of pair)
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
